descricao_original: The urethra in the penis is primarily lined by pseudostratified or stratified columnar epithelia. The epithelium changes to a stratified squamous in the fossa navicularis near the junction of the urethra with skin. Evaginations from the urethral epithelium continue as the mucus-secreting glands of Littre. 40x
